ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.subtitle: Describe your product in plain language and get a database draft you can edit.

ai.example2: A school with students, teachers, classes and grades
ai.example3: A blog with authors, posts, categories and comments
ai.architectureBody: The AI layer is isolated behind a single client. Without a server key it uses a deterministic local generator, so the app always works offline. Add AI_API_KEY on the server to switch to a real model — no UI changes needed.
